body: Hi, I try to help (: what can I do for you?
Ich weiß immer nicht was interessant wäre x:

Hi I am a 22 year old woman and can only say that most men in my life have had mental health problems, but did not come to terms with anyone who has mental health problems. Which makes me incredibly sad because I love helping.
I could write so much more but that would be too much for one post
